name: Question 14
problem:
| $x$ | $0$ | $4$ | $7$ | $15$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $1$ | $5$ | $6$ | $2$ |

Using the trapezoidal rule with the partition

$$
[0,15]=[0,4]\cup [4,7]\cup [7,15],
$$

approximate the area $A$ under the curve of the continuous function $y=f(x)$ whose data is given in the table above. Do not round the answer.

$A≈$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
Let's plot what this function might look like, using the values given in the table.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14055663/assets/a42b281338ce0fc7d64677b260f6c0d8cdaa47855afe35bae0c21fde750a39d5.png)

We've drawn some trapezoids to help calculate our trapezoidal rule sum. By calculating the area of each trapezoid, we obtain the following approximation for our area $A:$

$$
A≈\overset{1\text{st trapezoid}}{\overset{⏞}{[\,\frac{\overset{\text{bases}}{\overset{⏞}{f(0)+f(4)}}}{2}\,\cdot \,{{Δ{x}_{1}}_{⏟}}_{\text{height}}\,]}}+\overset{2\text{nd trapezoid}}{\overset{⏞}{[\,\frac{\overset{\text{bases}}{\overset{⏞}{f(4)+f(7)}}}{2}\,\cdot \,{{Δ{x}_{2}}_{⏟}}_{\text{height}}\,]}}+\overset{3\text{rd trapezoid}}{\overset{⏞}{[\,\frac{\overset{\text{bases}}{\overset{⏞}{f(7)+f(15)}}}{2}\,\cdot \,{{Δ{x}_{3}}_{⏟}}_{\text{height}}\,]}}
$$

Substituting the appropriate numbers into the above expression gives

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈\frac{1+5}{2}\cdot (4-0)+\frac{5+6}{2}\cdot (7-4)+\frac{6+2}{2}\cdot (15-7) \\  & =3\cdot 4+\frac{11}{2}\cdot 3+4\cdot 8 \\  & =12+\frac{33}{2}+32 \\  & =\frac{121}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
